registered_before: any score of the gate on LID-DS 2021 or CB-DS (the pool matrices are being computed, lidds_ml_v5.py has not run) and any fit with the extended normal
owner_decision: 10/11: learn the normal of pulse-live-v4-1109 too
why: in a sample of pulse-live-v4-1109 every false-alarm window of the token branch (146 of 146) holds a 4-gram never seen in the 12 h capture, and 90 of 118 normal episodes repeat an earlier signature (reports/Hướng cải thiện sau lượt v4.md): the burden comes from coverage of the capture, not from the threshold rule

extended_normal.data: pulse-token-capture-1107 as before, plus pulse-live-v4-1109 from its selection end (09/11 15:29) to its capture end, without the windows of a container from 5 s before to 25 s after the start of any campaign interval on it (idle control, benign launch, attack). The first 90 minutes of that run are left out: 5 pods behaved abnormally until 14:01
extended_normal.use: the same cross-fit over 30-minute chunks, token share 0.9; no learning while the system runs
extended_normal.risk: a trace of a trial outside the margins would be learnt as normal. The margins cover the 15 s process and its launch; the next live run tests the result blind
extended_normal.command: scripts/analysis/token_branch_fit.py ... --folds 5 --fold-seconds 1800 --share 0.9 --pool-level 0.01 --exec-hold 1 --extra-run <run root> --extra-span <selection end> <capture end>; the pool fits of every hold are stored, so the level and hold given here do not fix the choice

step_2.tool: scripts/analysis/pulse_v5_select.py: the trials of pulse-live-v4-1109 scored with the new fit; they are held out of it by the margins above
step_2.order: primary recall >= 95 %, lowest benign flag rate, a phase candidate before a hold candidate, the shorter seconds, the looser pool level
step_2.dropped: the criterion 'fewest normal episodes' of the protocol: the normal of pulse-live-v4-1109 is now learnt, so its episodes are no longer an out-of-sample measure. The burden is measured by the live run
step_2.phase_threshold: as amendment 1, computed by the same tool; scripts/analysis/token_phase_threshold.py is removed

probe: the live run uses the token build of commit a01b843 (/home/dat/pulse-tokens-20261110): the fexit variant and the legacy ABIs are removed, its four program sections are byte-identical to the build of 46e9039, and its collector proof passed on the three workers on 10/11
limits: the benign binary and the attacks of the next live run are the same fixture whose trials chose the gate; the admin commands are the blind class
